title: Special Services Professional Learning
before:
Asynchronous Professional Learning is Professional Learning opportunities available to access whenever you have time.  These modules are not scheduled for specific days and times, but rather available when you need them and have time.  Some of the modules are recorded videos and some are a combination of videos, articles, information, and activities.  Some modules are able to be completed in one sitting, while others may require you to access the components over several sessions.

notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.
631 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "Use the search bar to find resources within a sp" is an h4 with no h3 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Give the sub-headings their rule
decisions.why: 1 sub-heading is plain bold text. The design has a treatment for them — a teal rule down the left and a line across — and it had never been used on any page, because it needs a wrapper an author would have to know about.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
